summary_rationale: Price-blind fundamental and forensic audit confirms Arista Networks remains an elite asset-light compounder, though Q3 2026 footnotes and November 2026 competitive/governance updates reinforce a PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI stance. Revenue compounded ~26% annually over FY2016–FY2025 ($1.13B to $9.01B) and accelerated +44.3% YoY to $9.40B in 9M 2026 (Q3 +58.5% YoY to $3.66B), with GAAP operating margin reaching 44.4% in 9M 2026 (44.9% in Q3) and ROIC at 28.89% alongside $14.36B cash and zero debt. Offsetting these strengths: (1) 9M 2026 GAAP gross margin compressed 160 bps YoY to 62.9% on memory/silicon cost inflation and tariffs; (2) 9M 2026 CFO conversion moderated to 104.8% ($3.98B CFO, $3.79B FCF, 40.3% FCF margin) as evaluation inventory doubled to $874.3M and CapEx doubled to $184.9M, while Q3 Net Income included a $135.8M non-operating strategic investment gain; (3) customer and channel concentration remain acute (Microsoft 26% + Meta 16% = 42% of FY25 sales; top-2 resellers = 52% of YE25 AR; $11.4B binding purchase commitments and $152.8M EMS deposits without guaranteed Broadcom silicon contracts); (4) NVIDIA's Nov 17, 2026 8-K disclosed Meta expanding Spectrum-X/BlueField-4, NVLink Fusion extending to custom XPUs, and a Cisco USFP optics alliance (countered by Arista's Nov 17 R4 distributed inferencing launch); and (5) Q4 2026 insider selling (including Bechtolsheim's Nov 18 300k-share sale and Ullal's Oct sales/Nov 17 gift) occurred while buybacks stayed paused at $0 against a $1.7B unamortized SBC overhang.
